# Sensory

> > Sensory delivers high-accuracy, low-power on-device AI for voice, sound, and biometric authentication across embedded systems, edge devices, and mobile platforms.

Sensory specializes in on-device AI technologies that prioritize privacy, low latency, and minimal power consumption. The company offers a comprehensive suite of voice recognition, speaker verification, sound detection, and face verification products designed for embedded systems, wearables, automotive, healthcare, and enterprise applications.

## Key Topics

- On-Device AI
- Voice Recognition
- Wake Word Detection
- Speaker Verification
- Biometric Authentication
- Speech-to-Text
- Sound Detection
- Edge Computing
- Privacy-First
- Embedded Systems
- Low-Power Processing
- Voice Control
- Custom Grammars
- LLM Voice Agents
- VoiceHub

## Core Products

- [Smart Wake Word](https://sensory.com/product/smart-wake-word): Context-aware, adaptive on-device voice AI with flexible wake word detection
- [Wake Word](https://sensory.com/product/wake-word): Ultra-low power on-device wake word technology for embedded devices and edge computing
- [Personalized Wake Word](https://sensory.com/product/personalized-wake-word): User-defined, on-device voice activation enabling custom wake words in seconds
- [Secure Wake Word](https://sensory.com/product/secure-wake-word): On-device voice authentication with speaker verification for biometric security
- [Speech-to-Text](https://sensory.com/product/speech-to-text): On-device, private, low-latency transcription across Android, iOS, and chipsets
- [Phrase Spotted Commands](https://sensory.com/product/spotted-commands): Real-time multi-command voice recognition for on-device command control
- [Micro Language Models & Custom Grammars](https://sensory.com/product/micro-language-and-custom-grammar-models): On-device NLU processing with micro language models and custom grammar support

## Biometric & Sound AI

- [Text-Independent Speaker Verification](https://sensory.com/product/ai-text-independent-speaker-verification): Natural phrase voice authentication without requiring specific spoken text
- [Text-Dependent Speaker Verification](https://sensory.com/product/ai-text-dependent-speaker-verification): Phrase-based voice access control for secure on-device authentication
- [AI Face Verification](https://sensory.com/product/ai-face-verification): Private, fast, and secure biometric verification with liveness detection and anti-spoofing
- [SoundID](https://sensory.com/product/ai-sound-id): Real-time sound detection and classification AI for on-device audio analysis

## Development & Deployment

- [VoiceHub](https://sensory.com/product/voicehub): Self-service platform for creating and deploying production-ready wake words and commands

## Industry Solutions

- [Automotive](https://sensory.com/solution/automotive): On-device voice control and driver biometric authentication for vehicles
- [Wearables & Smart Glasses](https://sensory.com/solution/wearables): Ultra-low-power voice and sound AI optimized for wearable devices
- [PC, Mobile & Tablet](https://sensory.com/solution/pc-mobile-tablet): Voice and biometric AI integration for consumer computing devices
- [Healthcare](https://sensory.com/solution/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant voice and biometric AI for medical devices
- [LLM Voice Agents](https://sensory.com/solution/llm-voice-agents): On-device wake words, speech-to-text, and NLU for LLM-powered voice applications
- [Retail & POS Systems](https://sensory.com/solution/retail): Voice control and biometric authentication for retail and point-of-sale systems
